report:
Round 2 done — only src/calc.js and test/calc.test.mjs changed.

What changed
1. Every DEFAULTS row now carries used: true|false; assumptionsUsed rows carry used too, and overridden can only be true for a used row. An override aimed at a used:false key throws a plain-English error ("… is reference only and is not used in the v1 calculation").
2. slab_thickness_m is now the editable row and drives the slab volume. concrete_m3_per_m2_slab stays in DEFAULTS with used:false and is recomputed as slab_thickness_m × 1 m² on every estimate, so the derived row follows the thickness the user sets.
3. New DEFAULTS row rebar_kg_per_m3_ground_slab (50 kg/m³, Guessing). The ground slab uses it instead of the suspended-slab rate; traceability comment rewritten.
4. Sanity band updated to 7,000–13,000 blocks / 110–140 m³ / 10–16 t; SAMPLE_HOUSE untouched; golden snapshot re-pinned.
5. New tests: the full sweep (every used:true key ×1.5 must move totals or inputs; every used:false key must throw), the ground-slab rate test, the derived-slab test, plus a parity assertion for the new key.

New sample totals: 8,053 blocks (4,408 ext / 3,645 int) · 129.08 m³ concrete · 12.048 t steel (was 12.909) · 9,057.62 OMR.

Tests: 25 tests, 25 pass, 0 fail. Classic-script proof re-run, identical totals.

For builder B — 13 rows are read-only (used:false): block_ext_length, block_ext_height, block_ext_thickness, block_int_thickness, mortar_joint_mm, wall_height_default_m, ext_wall_perimeter_factor, ext_wall_thickness_mm, int_wall_thickness_mm, concrete_m3_per_m2_slab (derived), price_omr_cement_bag_50kg, price_omr_sand_m3, price_omr_aggregate_m3. The other 20 are editable; B reads row.used.
outcome: golden-rule fixes in; 25/25 tests; steel 12.9→12.0 t after ground-slab rate
